scope: CHAT-01 native company participant discovery with bounded literal search and current parent/permission/MFA/build authority

validation.skip: One existing opt-in ReportExportElapsedRetentionTest; unrelated to collaboration.

behaviors: Current active company members/accounts with chat permission only; self exclusion occurs in SQL before limit and cursor generation.
Three one-item pages have no duplicate/omitted eligible peer. Foreign company, inactive account/membership and missing-permission peers are excluded.
Literal percent search remains literal, query/page bounds are enforced, and positive Android/iOS client metadata is required.
No provider login, device allocation or queued job is performed. Selector response contains accountId/displayName only, not email, private profile or permission sets.
Acquired pages are withheld after native access/MFA expiry or scheduled module disablement. Invalid or revoked/replaced native parents do not acquire peer names.
Native HTTP rejects browser-only transport and missing chat permission; malformed cursor/limit are rejected. The provider fixture is intentionally unavailable while discovery succeeds.
Approval and lifecycle selectors preserve their optional-exclusion default and their post-read assurance checks.

correctedFailures.result: Two assertions used native_authentication_required instead of the existing stable native_session_invalid code. A third case exposed optional missing client metadata when no minimum build was configured; the new native selector now explicitly requires a positive Android/iOS build. Corrected selection passes all four data and 38 API cases.

limits: This endpoint selects potential contacts, not conversation or room authority. Commands must reauthorize peers; browser parent, conversation storage/control, SDK sync and UI remain to implement.
Live keyset pages are not immutable snapshots. Client query/company/account replacement must reset pagination.
No new migration, production configuration, real employee message or phone action occurred. No Starter port is due for HRIS participant policy.
